name: Alaska
credit: The New York Times 2024 precinct dataset marks Alaska results unusable because absentee, early and provisional votes are reported district-wide.
unavailable: Alaska has no precinct War Map in this release. The New York Times marks its 2024 precinct results unusable: absentee, early and provisional votes are reported district-wide and cannot reliably be assigned to precincts. Checked November 27, 2026.
